title: Festival work: Chick Webb tribute, Cab alumni and Nice
summary: In 1973 George Wein had him assemble a Chick Webb band with Ella at Carnegie Hall and a Cab alumni band. He played Nice in 1976 and 1977 and is booked for 1979 with Lionel Hampton.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: So now -- then so 1976 I went to Nice. In fact, in 1973 -- George Wein called me to put together a Chick Webb band for the Carnegie Hall with Ella.

And we did that. And I arranged the music and did that, and then the same year I did a Cab Calloway alumnus with Cab for this same festival. And then I went to the jazz festival in Nice in '76 and '77, and I'm going this year, in '79. In fact, in '76 I went just as a tenor player. '77 I went with Cab Calloway, and this year, in '79 I'm going with Lionel Hampton.
